goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Marketing owns demand creation, public discovery/presence, campaign efficiency and advocacy before/around Sales handoff; Sales owns qualified opportunity progression and commercial conversion.
Customer Care owns complaint/service recovery; Review & Referral Optimisation suppresses advocacy asks during unresolved dissatisfaction and routes negative feedback to care.
Scheduling/Dispatch owns operational capacity allocation; Marketing consumes capacity constraints for pacing/throttling but does not reassign workers or jobs.
Finance owns financial controls and approved budget ceilings; Marketing may optimise only inside authorised spend/pacing boundaries.
Channels, ad platforms, review sites, listing platforms, content generators, analytics models and attribution stores are tools/state, not separate agent identities.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
